source: GTA Fandom Wiki — Missions in GTA Online (MediaWiki API)
note: Per-mission payout data scraped from GTA Fandom Wiki. payout_hard_max = Hard difficulty, 16+ min completion. gta_per_hr uses community-verified completion times from GTAForums where known, rank-based estimate otherwise. Difficulty multipliers: Easy ×0.67, Normal ×0.83, Hard ×1.0. Player bonus: +10% per extra player above minimum.

strands.title: Lamar Davis
strands.notes: Low-tier contact missions. Fast solo rotations maximize $/hr.

strands.title: Lamar's Lowriders
strands.notes: 8 missions. Slightly better than base Lamar missions.

strands.title: Franklin and Lamar's Short Trips
strands.notes: Franklin & Lamar missions from The Contract. ~$150-200k per mission. Solo capable. Excellent payout for time investment.

strands.title: Gerald
strands.notes: Classic contact missions. Rooftop Rumble historically top earner.

strands.title: Gerald's Last Play
strands.notes: Criminal Enterprises update missions. Better payout than originals.

strands.title: Simeon Yetarian
strands.notes: Repo work missions. Among the lowest $/hr contact missions.

strands.title: Simeon's Premium Deluxe Repo Work
strands.notes: Heists-era missions. Marginally better than Simeon's base missions.

strands.title: Ron Jakowski
strands.notes: Trevor Philips Industries storyline. Standard contact mission payout.

strands.title: Trevor Philips
strands.notes: Standard contact missions. Sandy Shores-based storyline.

strands.title: Lester Crest
strands.notes: Lester's classic missions. Some are among the most efficient solo runs.

strands.title: Martin Madrazo
strands.notes: Martin Madrazo missions. Standard contact mission payout range.

strands.title: Madrazo Dispatch Services
strands.notes: 5 missions, Bikers era. Launched from MC Clubhouse.

strands.title: Brendan Darcy (A Superyacht Life)
strands.notes: 6 missions, requires Yacht ($6.5M+). Co-op only (2-4 players recommended).

strands.title: Agent ULP (Operation Paper Trail)
strands.notes: 5 IAA missions. ~$100k each, fast completion. Criminal Enterprises update.

strands.title: First Dose
strands.notes: 5 story missions unlocking Acid Lab. One-time story run; key gateway to ~$480k/hr Acid Lab income.
